scope: BIOS setting enumeration and dry-run selection validation on the 21VG target: `bios list` returns all 34 CurrentSetting items each carrying the real `GetBiosSelections` domain; `bios set --dry-run` validates a requested value against the firmware-returned selections and reports the change without writing.

target_build.toolchain: rustup stable 1.96.1 (stable-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc) + VS2022 BuildTools MSVC 14.44.35207 + Windows Kits 10 SDK
target_build.note: Built on-target from the exact main archive after cross-compile on Linux was blocked by missing MSVC import libraries (ws2_32.lib/dbghelp.lib) and the earlier staged exe predated PR60.

actual_cli_observations.error_detail: BIOS value "InvalidValue" is not one of the exact selections for HotkeyMode: Enable, Disable

protocol_correction.claim: The `ReturnValue` property synthesized by Invoke-CimMethod is not part of the raw `IWbemServices::ExecMethod` out-params object on this firmware.
protocol_correction.acceptance_rule: A successfully unmarshalled non-empty out-params object is the transport-success signal; business success is still judged by the declared out-parameter value (Selections / return / Data).
protocol_correction.independent_powershell_check: Invoke-CimMethod on the same class/instance returns ReturnValue=True plus Selections='Enable,Disable'; this confirms the firmware shape while also showing the synthesized ReturnValue that does not appear in the ExecMethod output.

magicbay_boundary.claim: MagicBay docking module is not physically attached on TB14P-EZRA.
magicbay_boundary.evidence: USB\VID_17EF&PID_7005&MI_00 shows PnP status CM_PROB_PHANTOM (the LTE2 module's USB function stack is enumerated by the BIOS but no physical device responds); no MagicBay service or downstream node is running. Hardware-absent, not implementable on this target.

limits: BIOS writes remain gated on `require_owned_staging` (staging-buffer ownership and isolation unverified by this PR's contract); no BIOS set/save/discard was exercised.
SetBiosPassword remains under --experimental and was not touched; PasswordState=0 confirms no supervisor password is installed on this machine.
MagicBay is hardware-absent on this target; no MagicBay code paths were exercised beyond enumeration.
Only dry-run validation was performed for `bios set`; actual staging and commit are still blocked behind the staging isolation contract.
